# NEW 2026-11-21 v10.5 Worker 3: Nova Elysia Three Religious Paths, Western Pantheon & Pyrophoroi/Copper-Clad Military (oe_eln_, 0 slots). Generated by gen_elysia_faith_military.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Country scope. O(1) settled Nova Elysia host gate (supports both W1/W2 host variable conventions).
oe_eln_is_elysia_host = {
	is_rebel_country = no
	has_global_variable = oe_ely_settled
	OR = {
		has_variable = oe_ely_is_elysia
		has_variable = oe_ely_is_nova_elysia
	}
}

# Country scope. Permanent identity gate for advance tree potential (never uses runtime-only global vars).
oe_eln_adv_potential_host = {
	OR = {
		tag = BYZ
		tag = ROM
		tag = TRE
		tag = FEO
		has_or_had_tag = BYZ
		has_or_had_tag = ROM
		has_variable = oe_ely_is_elysia
		has_variable = oe_ely_is_nova_elysia
	}
}

# Country scope. Religious path readers (1 = Western Orthodoxy, 2 = Nova Elysia Religio Romana, 3 = Symmachus).
oe_eln_is_path_orthodox = {
	var:oe_eln_faith_path ?= 1
}

oe_eln_is_path_religio_romana = {
	var:oe_eln_faith_path ?= 2
	exists = religion
	religion ?= religion:hellenism_religion
}

oe_eln_is_path_symmachus = {
	var:oe_eln_faith_path ?= 3
}

# Country scope. Western Pantheon unlock / seating status checks.
oe_eln_has_any_western_god_unlocked = {
	OR = {
		has_variable = oe_eln_unlocked_sol_hesperius
		has_variable = oe_eln_unlocked_oceanus_neptune
	}
}

oe_eln_has_any_western_god_seated = {
	OR = {
		has_variable = oe_eln_seated_sol_hesperius
		has_variable = oe_eln_seated_oceanus_neptune
	}
}

# Country scope. Access gate for Foederati Rangers (Path Foederati or v9.9 Chesapeake Foederati pact).
oe_eln_has_foederati_rangers_access = {
	OR = {
		var:oe_eln_native_path ?= 1
		has_variable = oe_col2_elysia_foederati_signed
	}
}

# Country scope. Iron foundry / copper shipyard geographical bases.
oe_eln_has_iron_foundry_base = {
	OR = {
		owns = location:kiskiack
		owns = location:patuxent
		owns = location:chesapeake
	}
}

oe_eln_has_copper_shipyard_base = {
	OR = {
		owns = location:nansemond
		owns = location:patapsco
		owns = location:chesapeake
	}
}
